sections.st: Why FMCG Thermoforming Packaging Requires Specialist Capability

strips.title: Food-Grade Certification — FMCG Packaging in Direct Product Proximity
strips.desc: All FMCG thermoforming packaging that contacts or is in proximity to food products must be produced from food-grade PP or food-grade APET — materials certified under IS/EU food contact material standards. Standard thermoforming materials are not food contact certified. Food-grade PP and APET are manufactured without restricted plasticisers, with migration-tested formulations. Material CoA confirming food-grade status is supplied per production batch.

strips.title: Celebration Gift Tray Geometry — Multi-Product Organisation at Premium Presentation Standard
strips.desc: Celebration gift trays for confectionery brands (Cadbury, Mondelez, Kinder Joy, Cornetto) contain multiple products — chocolate assortments, gifting sets, seasonal collections — that must be presented in a defined gift-ready organisation. The thermoformed tray is the brand's presentation platform at the gifting moment. Cavity geometry must hold each confectionery item in its exact position, with the correct orientation for the opening presentation.

strips.title: Large Brand OEM Consistency — Identical Specification Across Multiple Production Runs
strips.desc: Large FMCG brands require packaging specification identical across every production run — dimensional consistency, food-grade material CoA, and ISO 9001:2015 batch documentation per run. Any variation in cavity geometry or material specification at an FMCG scale is a quality event. In-house CNC tooling at Vapi and the same material grade per run delivers this consistency.

strips.title: Retail Display Format — Shelf Presence for Large FMCG Brand Products
strips.desc: FMCG retail packaging inserts are designed for the branded product's retail shelf position — the thermoformed insert holds the product at the correct orientation for the retail shelf facing. Crystal-clear APET for product visibility where required, or food-grade PP for tray applications.

sections.st: Three Problems Large FMCG Packaging Buyers Face

strips.title: Food-Grade Compliance — FMCG Supply Chain Requires Documented Food-Contact Certification
strips.desc: Problem: Large FMCG brands require food-grade documentation for all packaging components — standard thermoforming suppliers cannot provide food-grade CoA. Solution: Food-grade PP and food-grade APET with IS/EU food contact material certification per production batch. ISO 9001:2015 batch documentation per run. Documentation available for FMCG brand supplier qualification programmes.

strips.title: Celebration Gift Tray Specification — Brand-Exact Cavity Geometry
strips.desc: Problem: Celebration gift trays for confectionery brands where cavity geometry does not hold each product at the exact presentation position — products shift position during distribution, damaging the brand's gifting moment. Solution: Custom cavity geometry designed from every product in the gift collection. Physical product placement confirmed on prototype before production tooling.

strips.title: OEM Volume Consistency — FMCG Scale Production from Reliable OEM Source
strips.desc: Problem: FMCG brands at scale require a thermoforming OEM that can supply consistent bulk volumes — same specification, same food-grade CoA, same ISO 9001:2015 documentation on every production run. Solution: In-house CNC tooling held permanently at Vapi. Same food-grade material grade, same dimensional inspection per run. FMCG packaging manufacturer from Vapi Daman for domestic and export FMCG programmes.

faqs.q: What is the difference between food-grade PP and standard PP for FMCG packaging?
faqs.a: Food-grade PP is certified for food contact under IS/EU food contact material standards — it has a restricted additive list and has been migration-tested. Standard PP thermoforming grade is not food contact certified and should not be used for FMCG packaging in proximity to food products. Food-grade certification is confirmed per production batch by CoA.
